item.title: Re: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
First off, I did read the Guide for Newbies, and I have it as one of the tabs on the phone I am currently using.

Given that you edited a page that you didn't create without permission to include a substantial amount of completely new content, it looked to passersby that you didn't read the part of the GfN regarding editing.

though I would prefer you to be more specific on what you didn't find funny about it.

  • Though there's a lot of silliness in the article, the tone is played relatively straight, with the Foundation seeming professional overall in the actions portrayed. Having 1006 be introduced to 50-AE-J because of a drunk doctor makes the attempt at humor seem overly contrived and doesn't mesh well with the previous content.
  • Power-up-ing of 1006 (bites that result in flames?) seems too random.
  • "nuclear-powered fireballs" which I guess are supposed to reference the Cold War or something? Again, feels too random.
  • "a voice, sounding like that of SCP-50-AE-J, boomed through the air, saying "TASTE MY RIGHTEOUS BALLS OF PURE PATRIOTISM, YOU LITTLE COMMUNIST SHITS!"" > I could just be slow on the uptake here, but where is this voice coming from and how is it funny? Why is another character in the mix needed at all?
  • "his newfound PTSD, and Alzheimer's, alongside numerous instances of [DATA REDACTED]" > feels like you're treading close to tactless regarding digs at mental health there. Also, [REDACTED] or [DATA EXPUNGED].
  • The ending note referencing the Cold War seems tongue-in-cheek, but it's not as funny as the current ending note for the article before your edits.

If I ever decide to come back to this page to edit it, I will ask for his input on the matter next time.

Please ask for the author's input before making an edit.
